sources.name: poudrelibraries.librarycalendar.com
sources.notes: Seeded 2026-10-04 from the sources the content cites. Category guessed from the host name; type html until a feed is found. Found and read 10 November 2026. Poudre River Public Library District: Old Town Library (201 Peterson St), Council Tree Library (2733 Council Tree Ave) and Harmony Library (4616 S Shields St), all in Fort Collins. The platform is LibraryCalendar (Drupal) and it publishes one iCal feed for everything, https://poudrelibraries.librarycalendar.com/events/feed/ical (an RSS twin is at /events/feed/rss). robots.txt disallows /core/, /admin/, /search and the like but not /events/feed/, so the feed is allowed. It is large: 1.8 MB, 2,602 VEVENTs with each repeat written out (no RRULEs), reaching to 2029; every one has a street address in LOCATION and a ROOM. 287 are dated 10 November to 10 December 2026. About 20 are worth a row: Kevin Cook: Colorado Creatures (two dates), Election Debrief, A Day Away: Celebrating the Voyager 1 Space Probe, the Africa Lecture Series (Dr. Cynthia Brown on the Peace Corps in Botswana), Fort Collins Historical Society Talks: Women's History in Fort Collins, International Night Lecture Series: Pakistan, Friends of the Library Holiday Book Sale, Movie Matinee: Hoppers, Colorado Nutcracker Dreams (Front Range Classical Ballet Academy), Larimer Chorale: Candlelight Christmas, the reception for Art Harvest: Pastels by Julie Maas (3 December), From Planet to Person, Cycling in Winter, Fiesta familiar de Loteria. The other 265 or so are regulars or never-list: 143 storytimes, 27 'Meeting Room Open Hours', outreach desks (Outreach Fort Collins, Homeward Alliance, Larimer Health Connect), book clubs, yoga and tai chi, the Evie bookmobile's stops (some in Livermore and Bellvue), board meetings and closures. The exclusions suggested are on excludeTitles and locationFilter keeps Fort Collins addresses; expect to add more after a first dry run. Not fetched: the RSS twin beyond its headers. Confirmed 10 November 2026 on the owner's word ("Go 1 to 3", DECISIONS.md, "Twenty-four sources turned on"): the feed is one robots.txt allows, so it is read under honor. Set back to proposed the same day: the dry run was refused, because the host's robots.txt disallows the feed path, which the research had read as allowed. It was confirmed in error among the feeds with no robots question; reading it needs the owner's robots: subscribe for this source, which has not been asked.

sources.name: aggietheatre.com
sources.notes: Seeded 2026-10-04 from the sources the content cites. Category guessed from the host name; type html until a feed is found. Read 10 November 2026. The Aggie Theatre, 204 S College Ave. aggietheatre.com redirects to its promoter's page, https://www.z2ent.com/venues-we-book/aggie-theatre (Webflow, Z2 Entertainment); tickets are on Tixr. No feed found: /events/rss.xml and /rss.xml answer 404 and the page links no iCal. The page itself is plain HTML and lists every show with date, time and venue: 43 shows to 26 April 2027 on the first page (a second page exists and was not read), 14 dated 10 November to 10 December 2026, all worth a row, among them Cat Clyde and Dean Johnson (12 Nov), The Brothers Comatose (13 Nov), Space Wizard (14 Nov), Vansire (19 Nov), Krooked Kings (20 Nov), I in Team (28 Nov), HARBOUR (1 Dec), Horsetooth Honky Tonk (3 Dec), Wookiefoot (4 Dec) and Katya Grasso's album release (10 Dec); Latin Night, Emo Nite, the 2000's Rave and GIRL$ CLUB are dance nights in the same list. Two 'Private Event' rows in 2027 would need holding back. Robots: aggietheatre.com's own robots.txt (Cloudflare managed) names ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai and Claude-Web with Disallow: /, while z2ent.com's robots.txt holds only a sitemap line and disallows nothing; the listing lives on z2ent.com. Stays html: a person reads it.

sources.name: csurams.com
sources.notes: Seeded 2026-10-04 from the sources the content cites. Category guessed from the host name; type html until a feed is found. Found and read 10 November 2026. Colorado State University Athletics (Moby Arena, 951 W Plum St; Canvas Stadium). The site is SIDEARM Sports, which publishes one iCal for all teams at https://csurams.com/calendar.ashx/calendar.ics; robots.txt's rules for all agents disallow /common/, /images/, /documents/, /admin/, /services/, /site/, /hidden/ and /tags/, not this path. 198 VEVENTs to April 2027, no RRULEs; 38 dated 10 November to 10 December 2026, of which 13 have a Fort Collins LOCATION, and 12 of those are games worth a row: men's basketball v Portland State (11 Nov), Loyola Chicago (14 Nov), North Dakota State (18 Nov), UT Arlington (1 Dec) and Queens (8 Dec); women's basketball v Wyoming (13 Nov), Harvard (20 Nov), Weber State (22 Nov), Southern (5 Dec) and South Carolina State (9 Dec); volleyball v Fresno State (12 Nov) and Texas State (17 Nov) (dates in Mountain time; the feed is in UTC). The thirteenth is a placeholder, 'Football vs Flex Week' on 28 November with no time. locationFilter keeps home games; LOCATION reads 'Fort Collins, CO, Moby Arena' for basketball and only 'Fort Collins, CO' for volleyball and football, so the venue has to come from the sport. Summaries are long ('Colorado State University Men's Basketball vs Portland State'). Confirmed 10 November 2026 on the owner's word ("Go 1 to 3", DECISIONS.md, "Twenty-four sources turned on"): the feed is one robots.txt allows, so it is read under honor. Volleyball: the feed gives no venue for home matches, and the two listed on 10 November 2026 (Fresno State, 12 Nov; Texas State, 17 Nov) were given Moby Arena in review; the owner confirmed Moby Arena the same day. The owner then said every home volleyball match is at Moby Arena, so titleVenues names it for any volleyball item the feed gives no venue: later home matches publish without a person. Not checked against the live feed: later on 10 November the feed answered 403, then a redirect loop, after the day's several reads; whether that lasts is for Monday's run to show.

sources.name: music.colostate.edu
sources.notes: CSU Department of Music, University Center for the Arts, 1400 Remington St. WordPress with the Events Manager plugin; /events/ical/ is iCalendar (America/Denver), read 20 October 2026: 50 VEVENTs, 43 in the next 120 days, 45 with a LOCATION (the five without are webinars and information sessions), no RRULEs. The plugin caps the export at 50 items, so the far end can be cut off when the department lists more than 50 ahead. Noise to hold back: an umbrella 'Fall 2026 Student Recitals' spanning October to December, and the college's cross-posts (CLA Democracy Summit, CSU Scholarships Fair), which appear identically in the theatre and dance feeds too. Confirmed 20 October 2026 on the owner's delegation. Excluded by title: the department's studio and area recitals and chamber-ensemble class recitals (student coursework, not the ensemble concerts), webinars and information sessions, the honor band festival (schools), the Spur Music Lab (at CSU Spur in Denver) and the Parade of Lights preview (no place given).

sources.name: The Lincoln Center (lctix.com)
sources.notes: The City of Fort Collins' performing arts centre, 417 W. Magnolia St. Its own site (WordPress) has no events feed; its box office, tickets.lctix.com, is ShoWare, like the Rialto's, and the ticket site's event list is drawn by script from /include/widgets/events/performancelist.asp?action=perf&page=N, twenty performances a page (132 on 20 October 2026, to July 2027), read by scripts/lib/feeds/showare.ts; robots.txt allows it. Every row names the hall (Performance Hall, Magnolia Theatre) and the address. A few rows are untitled placeholders with no price, which the reader skips. Presenters' shows (the Fort Collins Symphony, OpenStage, Debut Theatre) are sold by the Center's own box office, which the standard counts as the organizer's ticket page. Confirmed 20 October 2026 on the owner's delegation; 18 published events already cite the box office. "TEST MAPS" excluded 9 November 2026: a seating-map test on the ticket site, with no date, time or description of its own, that the rules published for 20 November at midnight (gap report of 8 November).

sources.name: Wolverine Farm Publick House (events calendar)
sources.defaultVenue: Wolverine Farm Publick House, 316 Willow St.
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. Wolverine Farm Publishing's Letterpress and Publick House, 316 Willow St. in the River District: a nonprofit bookshop, bar and event hall. WordPress with The Events Calendar; the REST feed /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events answers (101 upcoming events, three pages of 50) and no event carries a venue, so defaultVenue is set. robots.txt disallows /wp-admin/ and /wp-includes/ only. 47 items dated 10 November to 10 December 2026. About 14 are worth a row: The Work Beneath: Artist Talk Series (10 November, 8 December), Residency Concert w/ Salome + Friends (11 November, 9 December), Special Concert w/ Brendan Nichols + Friends (13 November), A Mouthful of Blood: Writing the History of the American West, a poetry reading (14 November), Gulo Gulo Poetry Open Mic (17 November), Residency Concert w/ Stray Harbor + Friends (18 November), Nerd Nite (19 November), Music/Words/Film/Dance with Nick Jaina (21 November), Science On Tap (24 November), YART Sale (29 November), Residency Concert w/ DVNEHPPY + Friends (2 December), First Friday at the Publick House (4 December). About 13 are regulars (poetry collective and comedy writing meet-ups, Dead Pen Drawing Club, Queer Writes, Tight Knit, writing workshops) and about 20 are never-list: the twice-weekly happy hour, an umbrella 'Residency Concert Series (every Wednesday)' that doubles each named concert, 'Upstairs Closed' and 'Whole Space Closed for a Private Event' notices, a CSU department's hall booking and 'Happy Thanksgiving!'. Exclusions suggested are on excludeTitles. Only the first page of 50 was fetched. Confirmed 10 November 2026 on the owner's word ("Go 1 to 3", DECISIONS.md, "Twenty-four sources turned on"): the feed is one robots.txt allows, so it is read under honor. After the first read, 10 November 2026: "Merry Christmas!" is a closure marker and is excluded.

sources.name: Maxline Brewing (events calendar)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. Maxline Brewing, 2724 McClelland Dr #190, on the Mason Trail in midtown. WordPress with the Events Manager plugin, the same stack as the CSU department feeds: /events/ical/ is iCalendar, capped at the next 50 items, which is about a month here (50 VEVENTs, 10 November to 8 December 2026, no RRULEs). robots.txt disallows WooCommerce upload folders, add-to-cart URLs and /wp-admin/ only. Each VEVENT has a CATEGORIES line: 32 Food Trucks, 17 Community Events, 1 Live Music. Of the 41 dated 10 November to 10 December, 5 are worth a row: A.J. Fullerton and Jake Friel (19 November, 6:30 pm, indoors), Chili Cook-Off hosted by Sprague Roofing (20 November), Tea and Tendrils: Holiday Pop-Up (21 November), 970 Free Comedy Night (28 November; the feed gives midnight, the brewery's past comedy nights were at 8 pm) and Flingin' Pots: Create a Clay RAM or Sheep (29 November, a class). 10 are regulars (Trivia Tuesdays, Bingo Mondays, Stitch and Bitch, Board Game Connect) and 26 are food trucks or a 'No Food Truck' notice. The summer has more: the brewery books a named act most Thursdays and Sundays (the live-music category feed lists about 50 for January to July 2026). The category feeds (/events/categories/live-music/ical/) return the oldest 50, not the next 50, so they are no use; the main feed needs the food trucks held back by name, and the list on excludeTitles covers the trucks seen today but will need topping up as new trucks appear. Several one-off items have no LOCATION, so defaultVenue is set. Confirmed 10 November 2026 on the owner's word ("Go 1 to 3", DECISIONS.md, "Twenty-four sources turned on"): the feed is one robots.txt allows, so it is read under honor.

sources.name: Ginger and Baker (classes and events)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. Ginger and Baker, 359 Linden St (the guide has the place): a restaurant, pie shop and teaching kitchen in the old Northern Colorado Feeder's Supply mill. WordPress with The Events Calendar; the REST feed /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events answers with 107 upcoming events (three pages of 50; the first was fetched). robots.txt disallows WooCommerce upload folders and /wp-admin/ and asks for a crawl delay of 10. Venues are rooms ('The Teaching Kitchen', 'The Rooftop at Ginger and Baker') with no street address, so defaultVenue is set. 44 items dated 10 November to 10 December 2026. 3 are worth a row as events: Thanksgiving Makers Market (15 November, 9 am), Chef's Table November (29 November, 6 pm, $120, a ticketed dinner) and Santa and Pups and Kids Photo Event (6 December, 10 am, free); just after the window, Handmade Market NoCo on the rooftop (13 December). About 28 are ticketed cooking classes, each a different menu at $74 to $109 (Beef Wellington, 13 November; Fall in Tuscany, 20 November; Tamales, 28 November; A Night in Morocco, 9 December), plus a monthly book club and November Pie Bingo: regulars by the standard, though no two classes are the same, so the owner may want them. 13 are never-list: 9 'Booked for a Private Event', 'Closed for Thanksgiving', 'Last Day to Order for Thanksgiving!' and 'Thanksgiving Pie Pick Up Day'. excludeTitles holds the never-list and the plainest regulars only; the classes are left in for the owner to decide. Confirmed 10 November 2026 on the owner's word ("Go 1 to 3", DECISIONS.md, "Twenty-four sources turned on"): the feed is one robots.txt allows, so it is read under honor. After the dry run of 10 November 2026: 107 items, 71 staged, nearly all cooking classes; the feed files those under its own category "Class", which is now excluded, leaving the house events (the makers markets, the Santa photo morning). The classes are the owner's to bring back: remove excludeCategories. The cooking classes are back in from 10 November 2026: asked, the owner said yes, since each is a different menu. After the first read, 10 November 2026: "Closing at 3pm for Christmas Eve" is a closure and is excluded.

sources.name: Avogadro's Number (shows)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. Avogadro's Number, 605 South Mason Street: a restaurant and music room that has booked bands since the 1970s. The site is SpotHopper; the Shows page is plain HTML with every show's title, start and end time and price written out, but no iCal, RSS or JSON feed was found. robots.txt disallows nothing. 29 shows listed to 31 December 2026; 22 dated 10 November to 10 December, about 19 worth a row: Elise Wunder Mighty EP Release Party (12 November), Salsa Forte (13 November), Sumatra Earthly Garden Belly Dance (14 November), Harmony Hotshots (15 November), Courtlyn's Psychedelic Gospel (18 November, Mishawaka Presents, on Etix), John Magnie's Grocery Story (19 November), Just Jazz Quintet and Groove Avenue (20 November), Tumbledown Shack (21 November), Defunkl (27 November), Luck of the Draw (28 November), Soul Shaker and Friends Holiday Show (1 December), Songwriter in the Round (3 December), Poudre River Irregulars and Wendy Woo (4 December), Dave Dardine and High Plains Blues Society and Clark Street Station (5 December), We Be Three and Dance Night (10 December), and a CSU School of Sustainable Futures panel (11 November). Regulars: the Tuesday Open Mic (one listed). Never: 'Closed for Thanksgiving'. The guide already has a few of these by hand. Type html because there is no feed; the page is regular enough for a person to read in a minute.

sources.name: Magic Rat at The Elizabeth Hotel (events calendar)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. The Elizabeth Hotel, 111 Chestnut Street in Old Town, whose Magic Rat is a free live music room open Wednesday to Saturday; the calendar also carries the hotel's Sunset Lounge and Emporium nights. WordPress with its own calendar, no feed found (no iCal link, no Events Calendar REST route); robots.txt disallows /wp/wp-admin/ only. The page's HTML holds the current month in full. For 10 to 30 November 2026 it lists 10 Magic Rat nights, all worth a row: Behind the Scene of Kung Fu Panda, a film talk (11 November, 6 pm), Nadalands with Logan Farmer (12 November), Crescent City Connection (13 November), Ingrid Avison (14 November), Graham Good (18 November), Flock of Hummingbirds (19 November), StreatBeets (20 November), Delta Sonics (21 November), Barn Ghost (27 November) and Lid Dixon (28 November). December is loaded by script and was not read, except a featured Sunset Lounge Vinyl Listening Party on 2 December (monthly, a regular); at this pace expect about 15 music nights in a 30 day window. The calendar also repeats others' downtown events (the Downtown Lighting Ceremony, First Friday Art Walk), which should come from their organizers. The guide already lists some Magic Rat nights from this page by hand.

sources.name: The Comedy Fort (shows)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. The Comedy Fort, 167 N College Ave in Old Town, a full-time comedy club; all shows 21 and over. The site is SeatEngine; /events is plain HTML, and /events.ics, /events.rss and /events.json answer 404, so no feed. robots.txt is the stock file with nothing disallowed. (www.comedyfort.com, an older address, resets the connection.) 20 titles listed to 30 January 2027. Dated 10 November to 10 December 2026 there are 12 titles on about 18 nights, all worth a row: The Gateway Show (11 November and 9 December), Ryan O'Flanagan (12 November), Alvin Williams (13 and 14 November, 6 and 8:30 pm), Mom's Unhinged (15 November), Fort's Funniest semifinals (17 and 18 November) and finals (28 November), Eeland Stribling: Special Recording (19 November), Ben Roy (20 and 21 November), Rosalie and Friends (25 November), Jokechella! (27 and 28 November), Taylor Tomlinson (4 and 5 December, as the page lists it) and Quantum Arts (6 December). Regulars: New Material Night every Monday (4 in the window); the club also lists an open mic and classes on other pages, not read. A headliner's weekend is two nights with two shows each, so list it as a run or a row a night, not a row a show.

sources.name: Bas Bleu Theatre (upcoming performances)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. Bas Bleu Theatre Company, 401 Pine Street, an 'intimate salon' playhouse in its 34th season. The site is Wix; /bbtc-events ('Upcoming') lists every performance, no feed, tickets through a 'Reserve Tickets' button. robots.txt allows everything but lightbox URLs. 56 performances listed to 1 August 2027. Dated 10 November to 10 December 2026: 12 performances of two productions, Dancing at Lughnasa by Brian Friel (the home page gives the run as 13 November to 6 December; 11 performances) and It's A Wonderful Life: A Live Radio Play (from 10 December, 5 performances to 13 December); then The Listening Room, a songwriters' night (17 December) and Comedy Brewers, a family improv show, every other month (10 January). Warning for whoever reads it: fetched without a browser, the page prints each performance in the server's time zone, not Denver's ('Saturday, November 14, 12:30 PM' and 'Sunday, November 15, 7:30 AM' for what the run dates suggest are Friday evening and a weekend matinee), so dates and times must be read in a browser. The guide already lists Dancing at Lughnasa as a run. Best kept as a run per production, checked by a person.

sources.name: The Lyric (cinema, music and events)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. The Lyric, 1209 N College Ave: an independent three-screen cinema (The Mothership, Space Theater, Tiki Lounge) with a bar, a music calendar, outdoor movies in summer and community events. The site is an INDY Cinema Group application: the HTML is an empty shell and everything is drawn from POST requests to /graphql, so there is no feed and a plain fetch reads nothing; it was read with a browser (Playwright). robots.txt disallows /ahoy and checkout paths only. What the pages showed: four films on daily showtimes (Wild Horse Nine, La Bola Negra, Godzilla Minus Zero, Wicker) and recurring nights, Karaoke Club every Tuesday at 7 pm in the lobby, an Open Bluegrass Jam on Monday at 6 pm, There Will Be Gore (a horror series), Wild Card Wednesdays, Weekend Toons and Geeks Who Drink trivia. The /music and /upcoming pages did not list dated one-off concerts in the text a browser returned, so the number of one-off shows 10 November to 10 December 2026 could not be counted: not counted, not zero. Type html; a person has to open it. Film runs change weekly, which fits a 'now showing' note better than a row a screening.

sources.name: Old Firehouse Books (author events)
sources.notes: Found 10 November 2026; not read. Old Firehouse Books, 232 Walnut St (the guide has the place), is Old Town's independent bookshop and hosts author talks and book clubs. Its robots.txt names ClaudeBot, Claude-Web and Claude (with GPTBot, CCBot and others) under Disallow: /, so its events pages were not crawled and nothing was counted. One request for the home page was made by a probe script before the robots.txt had been read; nothing from it is used here. Type manual: a person checks it by hand, or the shop is asked.

sources.name: Eventbrite, events in Fort Collins
sources.notes: Proposed 10 November 2026, when the owner asked for a way to use Eventbrite. The place page is Eventbrite's search of the region around Fort Collins, not of the town: 49 pages of twenty. The reader (scripts/lib/feeds/eventbrite.ts) takes the first five pages, one every two seconds, and the location filter keeps what is in Fort Collins.
